faq.a: Solar energy is power captured from sunlight and converted into electricity by photovoltaic panels. It is clean, renewable and cuts your electricity bills.

faq.q: How much energy do solar panels generate?
faq.a: Depending on system size, orientation and usage, a well-designed system can cover anywhere from 60% to 100% of a household's electricity needs.

faq.q: Do solar panels work on cloudy days?
faq.a: Yes. Panels still produce electricity under cloud cover, only at a reduced output. Battery storage can balance production and consumption.

faq.q: How long do solar panels last?
faq.a: Quality panels typically last 25–30 years and are covered by long performance warranties.

about.storyTitle: Comfort, efficiency and practical engineering. Connected.
about.storyText: Based in Kyrenia and serving Northern Cyprus, Matek Energy brings together renewable energy, climate control, hot water, hydronic systems and electrical equipment. We help homeowners and businesses connect the right products with the planning and technical work needed to make them useful in real life.
about.audienceText: A family home, a new villa and a business do not use energy in the same way. We begin with how the space is used and work towards a system that fits its daily demands.

audiences.title: Homes & apartments
audiences.text: Cooling for living spaces, dependable hot water, heating and advice on solar options. We consider the existing installation, available space and how your household uses energy.

audiences.title: Villas & new developments
audiences.text: Plan solar, heating, cooling and hot water together instead of treating them as disconnected purchases. Early planning helps coordinate equipment, pipework, electrical needs and access.

audiences.title: Commercial & industrial spaces
audiences.text: Discuss ventilation, climate control, electrical systems and maintenance around the way your premises operate. Equipment selection should consider demand, access, servicing and business continuity.

about.servicesTitle: More than equipment. Support for the whole system.
about.servicesText: Our service range connects design, supply, installation and maintenance. Whether you are improving an existing system or planning a new one, explore each service to see what is included and request advice for your property.
about.shopTitle: Products and technical services, in one place.
about.shopText: Browse renewable energy equipment, heating and cooling components, hot water systems and electrical appliances. If you are unsure about compatibility or capacity, ask our team before placing an order. Installation scope and availability are confirmed separately.
about.processText: Good equipment is only one part of a successful system. Clear requirements, sensible planning and a careful handover matter just as much.
about.commitmentTitle: Make informed decisions. Not just quick purchases.
about.commitmentText: Our mission is to help customers reduce energy costs and improve comfort through efficient, safe and sustainable heating, cooling, hot water and solar solutions. The starting point is understanding what is appropriate for your property.

commitments.title: Advice grounded in the property
commitments.text: Capacity, layout, usage patterns and the existing installation all matter. We discuss these factors rather than assuming one product suits every customer.

commitments.title: A clear scope of work
commitments.text: Equipment supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance are different parts of a project. Ask us to clarify what is included in your quotation before approving work.

commitments.title: Support beyond product selection
commitments.text: Talk to us about operation, servicing and future maintenance. Product warranties and service terms depend on the equipment and agreed scope.

about.projectsTitle: See the work behind the company.

faqs.q: Do you supply products as well as install systems?
faqs.a: Yes. The shop brings together equipment and components, while our service pages cover installation and technical work. Contact us to confirm compatibility, installation availability and the scope for a particular product.

faqs.q: Can you help me decide which system I need?
faqs.a: Tell us about your property, current equipment, usage and goals. We can discuss the next steps and whether a site assessment is needed before recommending a system.

faqs.q: Can I discuss a renovation or a new-build project?
faqs.a: Yes. Early conversations help coordinate heating, cooling, hot water, solar and electrical needs. Share plans, photographs and your intended use of the space where available.

faqs.q: How do I request a price?
faqs.a: Use a service request form, book a consultation or contact us on WhatsApp. Starting prices on service pages are only an indication; the final scope, equipment and price are confirmed in your quotation.

blog.prepareTitle: Before you speak with an installer
blog.prepareText: A few details make the conversation more useful and help establish whether a site visit is needed.
preparations: Note your property type, location and the spaces or equipment you want to improve.
Have recent energy bills and existing equipment model details available where possible.
Share your priorities: comfort, consumption, available space, timing and budget.
Ask for the equipment specification, installation scope and service terms in writing.
blog.disclaimer: General guidance only, not a site-specific design or a savings guarantee. Installation, electrical work and system adjustments should be assessed and carried out by suitably qualified professionals.
